subject: 02_English_Language

questions.question: If you answer accurately, you answer...
questions.explanation: Accurately means with correctness and precision, without error.
questions.explanation_ar: accurately تعني بدقة وصحة، بلا خطأ.

questions.question: An assumption is...
questions.explanation: An assumption is accepted as true without evidence.

questions.question: A colleague is...
questions.explanation: A colleague shares your workplace or profession rather than working for you.
questions.explanation_ar: الزميل يشاركك مكان العمل أو المهنة، لا يعمل عندك.

questions.question: Competence is...
questions.explanation: Competence is the skill and ability needed to perform a task well.
questions.explanation_ar: الكفاءة هي المهارة والقدرة اللازمة لأداء المهمة جيداً.

questions.question: If results are consistent with a theory, they...
questions.explanation: Consistent with means in agreement with, not in conflict with it.
questions.explanation_ar: consistent with تعني متوافقاً مع، لا متعارضاً معها.

questions.question: A lab equipped with new technology has...
questions.explanation: Equipped with means supplied with the necessary equipment.
questions.explanation_ar: equipped with تعني مزوّداً بالمعدات اللازمة.

questions.question: An innate talent is one you...
questions.explanation: Innate means present from birth rather than learned later.
questions.explanation_ar: innate تعني موجوداً من الولادة لا مكتسباً لاحقاً.

questions.question: To nurture a child's dreams is to...
questions.explanation: Nurture means to care for something so that it grows and develops.
questions.explanation_ar: nurture تعني رعاية الشيء لينمو ويتطور.

questions.question: To capture a mood in writing is to...
questions.explanation: Capture here means to represent a feeling or atmosphere faithfully.
questions.explanation_ar: capture هنا تعني تمثيل الشعور أو الجو بأمانة.

questions.question: To exaggerate a story is to...
questions.explanation: Exaggerate means to make something appear larger or more important than it is.
questions.explanation_ar: exaggerate تعني إظهار الشيء أكبر أو أهم مما هو.

questions.question: A refuge is...
options: a payment made in deep secret
options_en: a payment made in deep secret
questions.explanation: A refuge is a place or thing that offers shelter and safety.
questions.explanation_ar: الملجأ مكان أو شيء يمنح الحماية والأمان.

questions.question: Someone resentful feels...
questions.explanation: Resentful describes anger at treatment that seems unfair.
questions.explanation_ar: resentful تصف الغضب من معاملة تبدو غير عادلة.
